preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each array is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) for a in arrays)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Total length of all arrays does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= sum(a) <= sum(max(a) - min(a) for a in arrays) for a in arrays)
postconditions.description: The sum of the final array is between 0 and the sum of the absolute differences between the maximum and minimum elements of each array.
